sentence: Please post your ideas in the forum below and we will read them.
synonym: share your thoughts in the section below
synonymNote: 两者都表示在下方区域发布自己的想法，意思相同

distractors.word: send your ideas to the teacher
distractors.note: 是发给老师，不是发布在论坛区域

distractors.word: read the ideas in the forum below
distractors.note: 是阅读想法，不是发布想法

distractors.word: delete your ideas in the forum below
distractors.note: 是删除想法，意思完全相反
